recipes.oracle_text: Intimidate (This creature can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or creatures that share a color with it.)

recipe_coverage: Reviewed evasion component: casting and exact payment, base characteristics, real combat declarations, five blocker colors, artifact and colored-artifact exceptions, colorless nonartifact blockers, flying/reach, shadow and horsemanship in both directions, unblocked damage, opposing ownership, persistent evasion after cleanup, populated owned zones and ordered libraries, combat snapshot/AI backup replay, and defending-player basic landwalk with matching/wrong/tapped/attacker-owned/removed lands where printed. Other activated abilities and flash timing remain explicit gaps. Component coverage, not whole-card certification.
